#   Bogon IP Address List
#   
#   This list contains all bogon IP address ranges that should not appear
#   as valid source addresses on the public internet. Bogon addresses are
#   either unallocated, reserved, or designated for special internal use
#   and are therefore considered invalid for external routing.
#   
#   These addresses are commonly filtered to prevent spoofed traffic,
#   misconfigured networks, and malicious actors from using non-routable
#   or fake source IPs when communicating with public infrastructure.
#   
#   Blocking bogon traffic helps reduce noise, prevent unnecessary processing
#   of invalid packets, and improve overall network hygiene and security.
#   
#   This list includes:
#      - Unallocated IPv4 and IPv6 address space (not assigned by IANA)
#      - Reserved private network ranges (RFC1918)
#      - Loopback addresses
#      - Link-local addresses
#      - Multicast and broadcast ranges
#      - Experimental or future-use address blocks
#      - Deprecated or historically invalid routing space
#   
#   Bogon lists should be regularly updated to reflect changes in global
#   IP allocation, as previously unallocated ranges may become publicly
#   assigned over time.
